kurz: The same sensation wears off quickly while eating: a contrast in texture, temperature or taste keeps every bite interesting.
bild_im_kopf: Like music with a single note: even a beautiful note gets boring after a minute, only change makes a melody.
was_passiert: Our senses quickly get used to a steady stimulus. The pleasure in exactly that sensation drops even while eating (sensory-specific satiety). A counter-stimulus resets attention: crunchy with [[cremig|creamy]], [[saeure|acid]] with fat, cold with warm.
warum_wichtig: Many classics live on this: affogato, chips with mayonnaise, risotto with crisp Parmesan, cucumber salad with a rich roast.
faustregeln: If a dish feels monotonous: add something crunchy on top, toasted nuts, crumbs or onions.
Serve something sour with rich food: gherkins, lemon, pickled vegetables.
Combine warm and cold: ice cream on warm cake, cold yoghurt with a hot curry.
